name: In Transit Delivery Notes
query:
SELECT 
    name AS "Delivery Note ID", 
    customer AS "Customer", 
    posting_date AS "Posting Date", 
    status AS "Status", 
    CASE 
        WHEN custom_in_transit = 1 THEN 'Yes'  
        ELSE 'No'  
    END AS "In Transit"
FROM 
    `tabDelivery Note`
WHERE 
    status IN ('To Bill', 'Draft')  -- Show only Draft and To Bill statuses
ORDER BY 
    posting_date DESC;
